title: Executor tool allowlist cuts startup tokens
what: The anvil-executor frontmatter declares a tools allowlist: core file, shell, and web tools plus mcp__anvil__*. It can be extended with orchestrator.executor_tools.
why: Subagents inherit every tool and MCP server by default (Blender x2, Jira, mobile, Chrome, computer-use). That made the executor's first prompt about 58k tokens; with the allowlist it is about 18.5k.
learned: With an allowlist, the mcp__anvil__* tools arrive already loaded and need no ToolSearch. omitClaudeMd saves only about 2k more, so CLAUDE.md is kept for quality. Edits to an existing agent file may not hot-reload in a running session for a while.
author: reactive-end
